photos.alt: Two people stand before an unfinished concrete shelter with brick walls, beside a stack of dry branches.
Small unfinished concrete structure with an open doorway and a window, set among palm trees and a brick wall.
Two men kneel on a concrete floor, pressing plastic bottles upright into a bed of gray mud to form a grid.
A low, flat-topped block of concrete with plastic bottles embedded in its side walls, standing on sandy ground beside steps and green plants.
Three people kneel beside a trench lined with green and blue plastic bottles, pressed into wet mud beside a building and leafy plants.
Blue industrial plastic shredder with a metal plate reading "PLASTIC SHREDDER," standing on a concrete floor in front of green trees.
A hand holding a small heap of clear, shredded plastic flakes, with more flakes of mixed colors spread out in a bin behind it.
Three people sit at a white-draped table; the woman in the middle, wearing a blue headscarf and face mask, speaks into a handheld microphone.
Four people sit at a long white-draped table in a meeting room, a woman in a pink and green headscarf and face mask holding a pen as she speaks.
Three people seated at a panel, the woman in the center holding a microphone and wearing a face mask, with a podium reading "Peshawar Serena Hotel" behind them.
Man in a grey suit and dark tie speaking at a wooden podium marked "Peshawar Serena Hotel."
Two people stand at a wooden podium reading "Peshawar Serena Hotel," beside a banner reading "Less Plastic.
